title: Whole Lobate River Delta and Open Sea
description: One newly authored complete stylised river-mouth terrain. A broad raised rear mainland is cut by one incoming channel which divides across a much lower outward-spreading lobate delta fan. The channel network opens through separate mouths into one broad surrounding sea-appearance surface, with low land tongues between the mouths. This whole mainland, fan, branching channels, shoreline and sea is one continuous closed shared-vertex solid with a finite underside; no separate water plane, old Y module copied into an array, or hook-shaped sand spit recoloured. Four constant opaque matte PBR roles. One terrain model zero scenes. Static illustrative appearance only, not a real place or scale, sediment process, hydrology, tidal/flow simulation, channel connectivity to other modules, habitat, navigation, walkability or engineering safety claim.
